## What it catches

`utils/`, `helpers/`, `misc/` files or folders.

## As `layout({ scope: "@hosti/" })` builds it

```json
{
  "name": "no-ownerless-files",
  "severity": "error",
  "module": {
    "path": "^(?:apps|packages)/(?:.*/)?(?:utils|helpers|misc)(?:[.][^/]*)?(?:/|$)",
    "numberOfDependentsLessThan": 100
  },
  "from": {}
}
```
